DailyReport.summary:
Cont. Drlg 17-1/2" HS to 165m, POOH to surface, Obs. 2 No. of NZL Seat area washed out, RIH w/ 17-1/2" Drlg BHA to BTM, Commence Drlg 17-1/2" HS to 225m.

Note#01 : Geo Data Mud logging EX monitor for driller not acceptable
Note#02 : Due to sever power surges  on 16-Oct-2024, some electrical appliances of mudlogging service got damaged (1No. 21" monitor, 2No. Case power, 1No. Motherboard, 1No. POE access point).

TimeLog24H.activity_description: Cont. Drlg 17-1/2" HS f/ 155 to 165m; NL. Due to Obs. SPP Drop gradually 100 psi. Check surface line & MPs; Ok. Decided to POOH to surface.
POOH w/ 17-1/2" MT Bit to surface. Obs. 2 No. of NZL Seat area washed out. Check another NZL; OK. (Bit Dull Grading: 1-1-WT-A-E-I-WO-BHA)
P/U & M/U 17-1/2" Bit (King dream, Used, 1X18/32" + 2 X Open NZL), 2 Jts 9-1/2" DC + 17-1/2" S.Stab (1/8" U.G) + 4 Jt 9-1/2" DC + X.O.S +
Commence Drlg 17-1/2" H.S f/ 165 to 192m, meanwhile apply limited parameters until S.Stab pass 20" Shoe; NL.
Cont. Drlg 17-1/2" HS to 225m; NL. Pump Bentonite Hi-Vis Pill to sweep hole periodically.

TimeLogMorning.activity_description: Cont. Drlg 17-1/2" HS f/ 225 to 250m; NL. Meanwhile pump Bentonite Hi-Vis Pill to sweep hole.
Cont. Drlg 17-1/2" HS to 280 m; NL. Meanwhile pump Bentonite Hi-Vis Pill to sweep hole.
Cont. Drlg 17-1/2" HS to 310 m; NL. Meanwhile pump Bentonite Hi-Vis Pill to sweep hole.
